description: Network sequencer of sixteen nodes, where the patch cables between nodes set which step follows which, allowing branches, loops and ratchets

params.text: Sets that node's mode: blue steps through its outputs in turn, orange picks one of them at random, and purple plays its connected nodes in quick succession
Sets the voltage that node sends to the CV output while it is the active step; the knobs span -1V to 1V until the range is changed on the menu

inputs.text: Advances the sequencer one step on each rising edge
Returns the sequencer to the first node and returns every node to the mode last chosen by hand
Triggers that node; patch it from the output of another node or from an external gate
A second trigger input into that node, doing what its X input does
A rising edge moves that node on to its next mode

outputs.text: Carries the gate of the step being played
Carries the CV value of the node being played
First output of that node, reached before its other outputs in cycle mode and the likeliest of the three when the odds are weighted
Second output of that node, reached after output A in cycle mode and less likely than A when the odds are weighted
Third output of that node, reached after output B in cycle mode and the least likely of the three when the odds are weighted

notes: The sequence goes nowhere until a node's A, B or C output is patched back into the X or Y input of another node on this panel; those cables are what set which step follows which
A node with none of its outputs patched to another node sends the sequence back to the first node on its next trigger
Bypassing this module leaves every output at 0V
menu: Randomize — a submenu whose CVs item rolls a new value for every node's knob and whose Modes item rolls a new mode for every node
Range — sets the voltage the CV knobs span, choosing among +/-10V down to +/-1V and 0V-10V down to 0V-1V, or Custom; changing it moves every node's value at once
Cycle — chooses Evenly, which visits each output the same number of times, or Weighted, which returns to the CV value between outputs so A comes round more often than B and B than C
Odds — chooses Evenly, which gives the CV value and the three outputs equal chances in random mode, or Weighted, which makes the CV value six times as likely as C, A three times and B twice
Ratchet Speed — chooses Whole Notes, Half Notes, Triplets, Quarter Notes or Dynamic, setting how fast a ratchet step plays against the clock
Low Peformance Mode — chooses On, which makes each node look for a trigger only while the clock is high, or Off; the spelling of the item is the maker's
+Pane Expander to Left (17HP) — places an eight-node expander on the left, and +Pane Expander to Right (17HP) places one on the right; several can be chained
